subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel missed-inbound catch-up contract now, with Slack and Discord as the first provider-owned implementations?
rationale: Current main only covers some providers through provider-specific durability/recovery, and the remaining Slack/Discord design changes channel permissions, configuration, ordering, and idempotency semantics.

options.title: Design replay contract and pilot Slack/Discord
options.body: Define the SDK/channel replay contract, cursor/dedupe storage, policy gates, and opt-in/default behavior before implementing the first stable-channel catch-up paths.

options.title: Finish in-flight restart recovery first
options.body: Keep this issue open while prioritizing #51620 and the queue/drain PRs before starting provider-history replay work.

options.title: Split by provider
options.body: Track Slack, Discord, and other channel catch-up as separate provider-owned requests if maintainers do not want a generic umbrella contract.

recommendation.title: Design replay contract and pilot Slack/Discord
recommendation.body: Define the SDK/channel replay contract, cursor/dedupe storage, policy gates, and opt-in/default behavior before implementing the first stable-channel catch-up paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses gateway restart behavior, channel runtime contracts, and provider replay semantics where recent history points to this owner as a good router.
